topic_ko: 유연한 시간 문화권의 회의는 가지를 뻗는 상록수처럼 진행된다
_note: 함축 의미(설명문) FULL set. 유형마다 passage 를 다르게 paraphrase. implication/grammar/vocab/blank 의 밑줄·빈칸 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재.

passage: In cultures that treat time flexibly, a meeting behaves less like a checklist and more like a growing plant.
An agenda listing a start time and a topic is usually sent out beforehand.
That document forms the central stem of the gathering.
Nobody, however, assumes the conversation will march straight down the list.
A concern that felt pressing when the agenda was written may matter far less today.
So the talk turns aside, side conversations open up, and members step out for urgent calls.
Managers there judge such detours as signs of health rather than failure.
The best sessions, they believe, develop in directions nobody could have scheduled.
choices: why written agendas should be abolished in international business
how time zones complicate scheduling across global branches
how flexible-time cultures treat meetings as organically branching processes
why managers in every culture prefer shorter and fewer meetings
how technology has replaced face-to-face discussion in modern offices
theme.explanation_ko: 안건은 줄기로 남되 논의가 그때그때 가지를 뻗어 나가며, 그런 이탈을 건강한 것으로 본다는 내용이다. '유연한 시간 문화권이 회의를 유기적으로 가지 뻗는 과정으로 다룬다'는 ③이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①안건 폐지 주장, ②시차 문제, ④회의 축소 선호, ⑤기술의 대면 대체는 모두 본문에 없는 내용이다.

passage: A meeting in a flexible-time culture is not a line but a tree.
The circulated agenda supplies a trunk, nothing more.
From that trunk, discussion sends out shoots toward whatever has become urgent.
Priorities set last week rarely survive untouched until the meeting itself.
Phone calls pull people out, and small clusters form in corners of the room.
Each of those clusters still traces back to the main topic in some fashion.
Skilled managers use these emerging needs instead of suppressing them.
Growth that cannot be predicted is exactly what makes such meetings productive.
choices: 회의의 효율을 높이려면 안건을 최대한 상세히 작성해야 한다.
여러 문화권의 회의 방식을 하나의 기준으로 통일할 필요가 있다.
회의 중 걸려 오는 전화는 참여자의 집중을 심각하게 해친다.
유연한 시간 문화권에서는 예측 불가능한 논의의 확장이 곧 생산성이다.
관리자는 회의 시간을 엄격히 지켜 논의의 낭비를 막아야 한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 안건은 줄기일 뿐이고 그때그때 떠오른 사안으로 논의가 뻗어 나가는 예측 불가능한 성장이 오히려 생산성의 원천이라는 것이 요지이다. ④가 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①상세한 안건 작성, ②회의 방식 통일, ③전화의 폐해, ⑤시간 엄수는 본문의 요지가 아니다.

passage: Picture a meeting in South America or the Middle East as an evergreen rather than a straight road.
The agenda arrives in advance and anchors the session like a trunk.
Yet the branches decide where the afternoon actually goes.
What looked urgent a week ago may already have faded in importance.
New shoots appear whenever a member takes a call or a small group forms.
None of these offshoots is treated as a mistake in the schedule.
The manager's skill lies in harvesting whatever grows on the day.
Interruptions, in short, are the meeting rather than an obstacle to it.
choices: Silence the Phone: Rules for Focused Meetings
One Agenda Fits All: Standardizing Global Business
The Hidden Cost of Long and Frequent Meetings
How to Write an Agenda Nobody Ever Ignores
Meetings That Branch: Growth Instead of a Straight Line
title.explanation_ko: 안건이라는 줄기에서 예상 밖의 가지가 뻗어 나가는 것이 곧 회의라는 글의 핵심을 압축한 ⑤가 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①전화 금지 규칙, ②안건 표준화, ③회의 비용, ④안건 작성법은 모두 본문의 초점을 벗어난다.

passage: A meeting in a flexible-time culture is more like an evergreen tree.
An agenda with a start time and a topic is circulated beforehand, and it serves as the trunk.
But there is no expectation that the meeting will progress in a linear manner.
What seemed like a priority last week is not necessarily the priority right now.
So discussion may branch off in a new direction as the day's concerns surface.
Other branches sprout when members step out for urgent calls, and sub-groups form to handle timely subjects.
Effective managers there capitalize on priorities and changing needs as they arise.
Interruptions, agenda changes, and frequent shifts in direction are seen as natural and necessary.
choices: a rigid schedule that every participant must follow without exception
a formal ritual whose value lies in its unchanging repetition
a private conversation held apart from the official meeting room
a living discussion that keeps branching toward whatever matters now
a written record that preserves decisions for many years afterward
implication.explanation_ko: '상록수'는 안건이라는 줄기에서 그때그때 중요해진 사안을 향해 가지가 계속 뻗어 나가는, 살아 움직이는 논의를 뜻한다. 방해와 방향 전환이 자연스럽고 필요한 것으로 여겨진다는 마지막 문장이 근거이다. ④가 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①엄격한 일정, ②변하지 않는 의례, ③비공식 사담, ⑤장기 보존 기록은 모두 '가지 치며 자란다'는 비유의 핵심과 어긋난다.

passage: A meeting in a flexible-time culture is more like an evergreen tree.
An agenda with a meeting start time and a topic will probably be circulated before the meeting, and it serves as the trunk.
But there's no expectation that the meeting will progress in a linear manner.
What seemed like a priority last week is not necessarily the priority right now, so discussion may branch off in a new direction.
Other branches may sprout as some members have urgent phone calls what take them in and out of the meeting.
Sub-groups may form within the room to discuss timely subjects linked in some way to the main trunk.
It seems clear that the most productive meetings grow in unpredictable ways.
Interruptions and frequent shifts in direction are seen as natural and necessary.
grammar.explanation_ko: ④ 앞에 선행사 urgent phone calls 가 있으므로 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사 what 은 쓸 수 없다. 선행사를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that(또는 which)으로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①안건이 배포되는 대상이므로 수동태 be circulated, ②expectation 의 내용을 잇는 동격 that, ③선행사를 포함해 주어가 되는 What, ⑤진주어 that절을 받는 가주어 It 은 모두 옳다.

passage: A meeting in a flexible-time culture resembles an evergreen tree more than a straight road.
An agenda naming the start time and topic is circulated in advance and serves as the trunk.
But nobody expects the session to progress in a linear manner.
What seemed like a priority last week is not necessarily the priority right now.
So discussion may branch off in a new direction whenever fresh concerns surface.
Sub-groups may form within the room to discuss outdated subjects linked to the main meeting trunk.
The effective manager is flexible enough to capitalize on changing needs as they arise.
Interruptions and shifts in direction are therefore seen as natural and necessary.
vocab.explanation_ko: ④ 소그룹이 논의하는 것은 지금 막 중요해진 '시의적절한(timely)' 주제이다. outdated(시대에 뒤떨어진)는 '변화하는 요구를 활용한다'는 글의 흐름과 정반대이므로 timely 로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①circulated(배포된), ②linear(선형적인), ③branch off(갈라져 나가다), ⑤capitalize on(~을 활용하다)은 모두 문맥에 알맞다.

passage: In flexible-time cultures a meeting grows the way an evergreen tree does.
The agenda circulated beforehand supplies the trunk of that tree.
But no one expects the session to move along a single straight line.
Priorities fixed a week earlier often lose their urgency by the meeting day.
Discussion therefore branches off, side groups form, and members come and go.
Every one of these offshoots still connects back to the main trunk in some way.
For this reason, the most productive meetings there grow in unpredictable ways.
Interruptions and changes of direction are read as signs of life, not disorder.
blank.explanation_ko: 우선순위가 바뀌고 논의가 가지를 뻗으며 사람들이 드나든다는 앞 내용으로 보아, 가장 생산적인 회의는 '예측할 수 없는 방식으로(unpredictable ways)' 자란다는 흐름이다. ①이 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ②정해진 시간 단계, ③엄격히 적힌 순서, ④완전한 침묵, ⑤해마다 동일한 주기는 모두 '가지 뻗는 예측 불가능성'과 어긋난다.

irrelevant.intro: In flexible-time cultures, a meeting is less a straight path than an evergreen tree that keeps putting out new branches.
sentences: The agenda sent around before the meeting supplies the trunk of that tree.
Priorities that mattered last week may have faded, so discussion branches off in a new direction.
New office buildings in the region increasingly use glass walls to reduce lighting costs.
Sub-groups also form in the room to handle timely subjects tied to the main trunk.
Managers therefore treat interruptions and shifts in direction as natural and necessary.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 유연한 시간 문화권 회의가 가지를 뻗듯 진행된다는 내용인데, ③ '유리벽 사무 건물이 조명비를 줄인다'는 건축·비용 이야기로 주제와 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②④⑤는 모두 안건이라는 줄기와 그로부터 뻗는 가지라는 비유로 자연스럽게 이어진다.

order.given: A meeting in a flexible-time culture is more like an evergreen tree than a straight road.

blocks.A: From that trunk, however, the discussion is free to branch off, because what seemed like a priority last week may not be the priority today.
blocks.B: An agenda listing a start time and a topic is circulated in advance, and this document serves as the trunk of the tree.
blocks.C: Managers there consequently regard interruptions, agenda changes, and shifts in direction as natural and necessary parts of a productive session.

order.explanation_ko: 나무 비유(주어진 글) 다음에 (B)가 '줄기'에 해당하는 안건을 소개하고, (A)가 'From that trunk, however'로 그 줄기에서 가지가 뻗는다는 반전을 잇고, (C)가 그래서 방해와 변경을 자연스럽게 본다는 결론을 맺는다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'that trunk'는 (B)에서 줄기를 정의한 뒤에야 가리킬 대상이 생기고, (C)의 'consequently'는 가지치기 설명 뒤에 와야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: But there's no expectation that the meeting will progress in a linear manner.

passage_marked.text: A meeting in a flexible-time culture is more like an evergreen tree.
An agenda with a meeting start time and a topic will probably be circulated before the meeting, and this serves as the trunk of the tree.
What seemed like a priority last week is not necessarily the priority right now, so discussion may branch off in a new direction.
Other branches may sprout as members take urgent calls, and sub-groups may form to discuss timely subjects.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 'But'으로 안건이 줄기 역할을 한다는 설명(②앞)을 뒤집고, 뒤이어 우선순위 변화로 논의가 갈라진다는 구체적 설명이 이어져야 자연스럽다. 따라서 ②가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 문장이 없으면 안건이라는 줄기 설명에서 곧바로 '갈라져 나간다'로 넘어가 역접의 논리가 사라진다.

passage: A meeting in a flexible-time culture is more like an evergreen tree than a straight line.
The agenda circulated in advance provides only the trunk.
No one expects the session to progress in a linear manner.
Priorities set last week are not necessarily the priorities of the moment.
Discussion branches off, members take urgent calls, and sub-groups form.
Every offshoot remains tied to the main meeting trunk in some way.
Effective managers capitalize on the priorities and needs that arise.
Interruptions and shifts of direction are seen as natural and necessary.
summary.summary_template: In flexible-time cultures the agenda works only as a __(A)__, and a meeting is judged productive when it __(B)__ toward whatever has become important.
summary.explanation_ko: 안건은 줄기, 즉 (A)starting frame(출발 틀)일 뿐이며, 회의는 그때그때 중요해진 쪽으로 (B)branches(가지를 뻗을) 때 생산적이라고 평가된다. ②가 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 verdict/final record/strict rule 이 아니라 출발 틀이며, (B)는 returns/narrows/freezes 가 아니라 branches 여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그러나 회의가 선형적인 방식으로 진행되리라는 기대는 없다.
writing.answer: But there is no expectation that the meeting will progress in a linear manner.
writing.explanation_ko: expectation 뒤의 that절은 내용을 설명하는 동격 명사절이고, in a linear manner 는 '선형적인 방식으로'라는 방법 부사구이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 방해, 안건 변경, 그리고 잦은 방향 전환은 자연스럽고 필요한 것으로 여겨진다.
writing.answer: Interruptions, agenda changes, and frequent shifts in direction are seen as natural and necessary.
writing.explanation_ko: see A as B(A를 B로 여기다)의 수동형 be seen as ~ 를 쓰고, natural 과 necessary 를 형용사로 병렬한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 유능한 관리자는 우선 사항과 변화하는 요구가 생겨날 때 그것을 활용할 만큼 충분히 유연하다.
conditions: 형용사 + enough + to부정사 구문을 사용할 것
as they arise 로 끝낼 것
writing.answer: The effective manager is flexible enough to capitalize on priorities and changing needs as they arise.
writing.explanation_ko: enough 는 형용사 뒤에 놓여 flexible enough to V 어순이 되며, capitalize on 은 '~을 활용하다', as they arise 는 '그것들이 생겨날 때'이다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: What seemed like a priority last week when the agenda was crafted is not necessarily the priority right now ― so discussion may branch off in a new direction.
writing.answer: 안건이 작성된 지난주에 우선 사항처럼 보였던 것이 지금도 반드시 우선 사항인 것은 아니며, 그래서 논의가 새로운 방향으로 갈라져 나갈 수도 있다.
writing.explanation_ko: 관계대명사 What 이 이끄는 명사절이 주어이고, not necessarily 는 '반드시 ~인 것은 아니다'라는 부분 부정, branch off 는 '갈라져 나가다'이다.

writing.question: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.context: The agenda is only the ___________ of the tree, and the real discussion grows outward from it as branches.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문에서 안건은 나무의 '줄기(trunk)' 역할을 하고, 논의는 그로부터 뻗어 나가는 가지에 해당한다.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Because meetings there do not follow a (A)___________ path, interruptions and changes of direction are treated as (B)___________ rather than as problems.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 회의는 '선형적인(linear)' 경로를 따르지 않으며, (B) 그래서 방해와 방향 전환은 문제가 아니라 '필요한(necessary)' 것으로 다루어진다.
